title: Patient 17's implant, cut from his leg and tested for zinc-64

tellings.quote: Like patient 17, terrifying. He didn't tell me that till after I saw it got cut out of his leg.

plain: Sometime in the 2010s, a man known as "Patient 17" had a small object, which some believe was an implant placed in his body by non-human beings, cut out of his leg, and it was later tested for zinc-64, a particular form of the metal zinc. Jeremy Corbell tells Michels he saw the object removed and that the man only told him his "terrifying" story afterwards. If true, it would point to physical evidence left in a human body.
